# Generated files policy

This policy applies after E6. It separates reproducible source inputs from
local build output so a clean clone can build without committing caches.

## Tracked generated files

The following generated outputs remain tracked because the current repository
and CI-equivalent workflow expect them to be available and reviewable:

- `lib/core/database/app_database.g.dart`, generated by Drift/build_runner;
- `lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart`, generated from the two ARB sources;
- Flutter platform registrants and CMake metadata under `windows/flutter/`;
- Flutter project metadata (`.metadata`) and native runner projects.

Do not edit these by hand. Regenerate Drift with
`dart run build_runner build` and localization with `flutter gen-l10n`, then
review the diff. A generated diff belongs in the same commit as its source
schema/ARB change.

## Local-only generated files

The following are always ignored and are safe to regenerate:

- `.dart_tool/`, `build/`, `dist/`;
- `.flutter-plugins` and `.flutter-plugins-dependencies`;
- `android/.gradle/`, `android/local.properties`;
- `windows/flutter/ephemeral/`;
- APK, AAB, ZIP, PDB, LIB, EXP, code-size and symbol output;
- coverage, logs, temporary files, databases, exports, signing material, and
  certificates.

Release binaries, size-analysis JSON, and symbol maps must be retained outside
Git with checksums when they are release evidence. They are not source.

## Clean-clone sequence

```powershell
flutter pub get
flutter gen-l10n
dart run build_runner build
flutter test test/architecture/offline_architecture_test.dart
flutter analyze
flutter test
```

`tool/clean_workspace.ps1` is dry-run by default. Review its explicit list,
then use `-Apply` only after artifacts that need retention have been copied
outside the repository. It never targets source, Git, AppData, databases, or
exports outside the working tree.
